name: diff-review
description: Review the current git diff or a specified commit/commit range
instructions: If reviewing the working tree, run `git diff` to see unstaged changes
If reviewing staged changes, run `git diff --cached`
If a commit ref or range is specified, use `git diff <ref>` or `git log --oneline <range>`
Review for correctness, security, style consistency, and adherence to project conventions
Check for hardcoded secrets, API keys, or credentials
Verify that external API calls follow the established patterns
Ensure UI changes match the project's flat design aesthetic (no rounded corners, no shadows, system fonts only)
Return a structured review: summary, positives, concerns, suggestions
